From today, Runna subscription users can access the brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna launches training tools designed for hot weather

The personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, designed to support users throughout their entire training cycle — from training in hot weather to post-race recovery — everything you need is covered.

The brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature goes live today. Runna will help users identify cooler running times and suggest adjusted pace targets based on felt air temperature, training duration and specific sessions.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature will display hourly colour-coded weather forecasts, allowing users to quickly identify the most suitable times for running so they can plan accordingly.

Here is Runna's introduction to the new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature — once a user activates a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K, the system will automatically generate a relevant plan. Runna's head coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of wear and tear or injury."

Lastly, the platform also announced that a new feature called "Future Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans, which will automatically and seamlessly transition to the next plan when the current one ends, further streamlining the long-term training process.

Here is Runna's introduction to the advantages of the "Future Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: runners can stack multiple races, phase goals and training cycles for a clear year-round overview. Zero management between plans: no need to rebuild or start from scratch — your preferred training schedule, predicted race times and current fitness level will automatically carry over after your existing plan ends. Flexible and fully autonomous: every plan can be edited, swapped or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: every plan is designed by Runna's senior coaching team based on established training principles, supporting sustainable progress, recovery and race-day preparation.
